item.text: {"text":"HSTU already has a strong objective-only reference: Meta’s released configuration uses sampled softmax, 128 local negatives, temperature 0.05, and L2-normalized item/user embeddings. These are reference settings, not established optima for the four Amazon categories. [Official HSTU configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin). Harder negatives need false-negative control: Hard-BPR (2024) modifies the pairwise objective specifically for dynamic hard sampling, reducing the influence of potential positives mislabeled as negatives. Its evidence concerns implicit collaborative filtering; transfer to HSTU remains a hypothesis. [Hard-BPR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19276). R2NS (WWW 2026) combines uniform-sampling warm-up, global candidate recall, and progressively harder negative selection; its experiments support delaying aggressive mining and avoiding deterministic selection of only the highest-scoring unobserved item. [R2NS](https://renzhaochun.github.io/assets/pdf/WWW_2026_Camera_Ready.pdf).\n\nSampling changes can also alter popularity bias. A 2024 sequential-recommendation study found uniform negatives favored head items, while popularity-based and in-batch negatives offered more balanced popularity-band performance, sometimes sacrificing aggregate accuracy. [Sampling comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17276). Separately, corrected sampled-rank estimates enable efficient WARP/LambdaRank optimization, addressing sampling bias rather than identifying false negatives. [Rank correction](https://research.google/pubs/improved-estimation-of-ranks-for-learning-item-recommenders-with-negative-sampling/). Practical inference: retain one HSTU per category and compare sampled softmax against a warm-started, stochastic hard-negative objective with bounded influence for extreme negatives. Exclude known training positives using public histories only. Neither lower pairwise error nor larger training margins establishes generalization; select exclusively by the pinned macro validation HR@10."}
